turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to stop buying coffee every morning and make it at home instead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good plan, you'll save a lot. Do you want something simple like a French press, or are you ready to invest in an espresso machine?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me talk to Omar for a bit, so please stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you taste this sauce? Is it too salty?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hmm, a little bit. Not terrible though.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, I knew it. I added the stock and forgot it was already salted.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just throw in some more tomatoes, that usually fixes it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good idea. Do you know if we have another tin?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Decided between the French press and the espresso machine?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: French press. I just want something that works at six in the morning.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great choice. Use coarse ground coffee and let it steep for about four minutes.
